@5046 := "# Generated by `verdant-studio publish` from studio/src/Studio/Ops.lex.tex. Do not edit.\nname: pages\n\non:\n  pull_request:\n  push:\n    branches: [main]\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: pages-${{ github.ref }}\n  cancel-in-progress: true\n\njobs:\n  studio:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 30\n    permissions:\n      contents: read\n      pull-requests: read\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2\n        with:\n          persist-credentials: false\n      - name: accept only pull requests made through the API\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n          AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          app='afflom-verdant-studio[bot]'\n          if [ \"$AUTHOR\" != \"$app\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::$AUTHOR opened this pull request. Only $app, through the operate workflow, changes this repository.\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          others=$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR}/commits\" --paginate --jq \".[] | select(.author.login != \\\"$app\\\") | .sha\")\n          if [ -n \"$others\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::these commits were not made by $app: $others\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38\n        with:\n          node-version: '24'\n      - id: command\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/release/verdant_studio\n          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**') }}\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.npm\n          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1\n      - if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/lexlean\n          key: lexlean-0.4.3\n      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)\n        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean\n          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified\n          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n      - name: check, build and publish through the API\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          target/release/verdant_studio check\n          target/release/verdant_studio build\n          target/release/verdant_studio publish\n          git diff --exit-code\n      - if: github.event_name == 'push'\n        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3.0.1\n        with:\n          path: app/.prism/site\n\n  pages:\n    if: github.event_name == 'push'\n    needs: studio\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    permissions:\n      pages: write\n      id-token: write\n    environment:\n      name: github-pages\n      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}\n    steps:\n      - id: deployment\n        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4.0.5\n"

Do not edit.\n# The one way an agent changes this repository: dispatch this workflow with an\n# operation of the API. id: app\n        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@5d869da34e18e7287c1daad50e0b8ea0f506ce69 # v1.11.0\n        with:\n          app-id: ${{ vars.VERDANT_STUDIO_APP_ID }}\n          private-key: ${{ secrets.VERDANT_STUDIO_APP_KEY }}\n      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2\n        with:\n          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}\n      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38\n        with:\n          node-version: '24'\n      - id: command\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/release/verdant_studio\n          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**') }}\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.npm\n          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1\n      - if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/lexlean\n          key: lexlean-0.4.3\n      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)\n        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean\n          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified\n          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n      - name: run the operation, then check and build through the API\n        env:\n          ARGS: ${{ inputs.args || 'advance' }}\n          INPUT: ${{ inputs.input }}\n          INPUT_NAME: ${{ inputs.input_name }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail -f\n          if [ -n \"$INPUT\" ]; then\n            case \"$INPUT_NAME\" in */*|.*|'') echo \"input_name must be a plain file name\" >&2; exit 1;; esac\n            mkdir -p target/input; cat > \"target/input/$INPUT_NAME\" <<< \"$INPUT\"\n          fi\n          if [ \"$ARGS\" = advance ]; then\n            : > target/operation.txt\n            last=''\n            while op=$(target/release/verdant_studio next) && [ -n \"$op\" ]; do\n              if [ \"$op\" = \"$last\" ]; then echo \"::error::$op did not settle\"; exit 1; fi\n              target/release/verdant_studio $op | tee -a target/operation.txt\n              last=$op\n            done\n          else\n            target/release/verdant_studio $ARGS | tee target/operation.txt\n          fi\n          target/release/verdant_studio build\n          target/release/verdant_studio check\n      - name: open a pull request as the Verdant Studio app\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}\n          SLUG: ${{ steps.app.outputs.app-slug }}\n          ARGS: ${{ inputs.args || 'advance' }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git add -A\n          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo \"no change\"; exit 0; fi\n          id=$(gh api \"users/${SLUG}[bot]\" --jq .id)\n          git -c user.name=\"${SLUG}[bot]\" -c user.email=\"${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\" commit -q -F - <<MSG\n          verdant_studio $ARGS\n\n          $(cat target/operation.txt)\n          MSG\n          branch=\"studio/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git push origin \"HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}\"\n          gh pr create --head \"$branch\" --base main --title \"verdant_studio $ARGS\" --body-file target/operation.txt\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/rules/branches/main\" > target/rules.json\n          if [ \"$(target/release/verdant_studio merge-gate target/rules.json)\" = merge ]; then\n            gh pr merge \"$branch\" --auto --squash --delete-branch\n          else\n            echo \"::notice::main does not require the studio check, so this pull request waits for the owner's merge\"\n          fi\n"
